statement: Opening on the strongest line plus a POV caption holds more viewers at 3 seconds than opening on setup.
Exact times and numbers on screen (3:47 AM, 41 minutes) draw more 'this is me' comments than vague ones.
Ending on a vote between characters raises comments per 1,000 views.
A score that follows the story beats (silence before the punchline, hit on the twist) beats sound effects only.
Episodes under 30 seconds complete better than 30-45 second ones without losing follows.
A caption whose first line states the premise cuts 'I don't get it' comments.
A first-frame text hook that opens a curiosity gap (a label ending in a colon, or a line that withholds the payoff) raises 3-second hold.
Holding the payoff until the last second raises completion.
One point of attention at a time (one character in focus, one short line, text and speech never competing) raises 3-second hold and average watch time.
